title: English Practice Quiz 0785
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 01: Preventive maintenance is performed to?
options: reduce the likelihood of equipment failure
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: reduce the likelihood of equipment failure.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 02: A maintenance request should include?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: the asset, problem and location.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 03: A faulty electrical socket should be?
options: isolated if safe and reported to qualified staff
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: isolated if safe and reported to qualified staff.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 04: A maintenance log records?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: work performed, dates and observations.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 05: A planned inspection helps?
options: identify defects before they cause disruption
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: identify defects before they cause disruption.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 06: A service-level agreement defines?
options: the expected service standards and responsibilities
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: the expected service standards and responsibilities.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 07: A building access system should be maintained by?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: authorised and competent personnel.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 08: A blocked drainage line should be?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: reported and addressed promptly.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 09: Spare parts inventory helps?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: reduce delays during repairs.

questions.question: Facilities and Maintenance 10: After maintenance, equipment should be?
options: checked before being returned to service
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: checked before being returned to service.
